findings.why: The four mirror events live in dossiers fx-48 does not own (fourteenth-dynasty-of-egypt ledger/1 and successors[hyksos]; middle-kingdom-of-egypt ledger/12, ledger/15 and successors[hyksos]; abydos-dynasty ledger/1), so they are handed off, not edited. Pages re-opened in this run support the repoint to fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt. hyksos itself is unchanged this round (Sharuhen only) and validates with 0 errors; new-kingdom-of-egypt ledger/2 and predecessors[hyksos] (Sharuhen) stay as they are. At the time of this run all five mirror events still name hyksos as counterpart.

handoffs.where: ledger/1 (-1650 loss, Avaris 110 km 'the Nile Delta') and identity.successors[0] (slug hyksos)
handoffs.what: set ledger/1 counterpart hyksos -> fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt and identity.successors[hyksos].slug -> fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt (keep land and note text; the note may say the Fifteenth Dynasty of the Hyksos)
handoffs.why: hyksos no longer carries the Egyptian gain (it is now only Sharuhen, found -1650 / loss+dissolve -1550); the Egyptian land is held by fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt (ledger/0 found from fourteenth-dynasty-of-egypt, ledger/1-2 gains from middle-kingdom-of-egypt). A loss or dissolve whose counterpart is hyksos would hand Delta, Middle Egypt and Abydos cells to hyksos, so the counterpart must be the Fifteenth Dynasty. Hyksos page: the Hyksos 'were the kings of the Fifteenth Dynasty of Egypt'; Fifteenth Dynasty page: 'the first Hyksos dynasty, ruling from Avaris', 'led his people into an occupation of the Nile Delta area', 'expanded to occupy Memphis', 'These events put an end to the Fourteenth Dynasty of Egypt', 'the fall of the Thirteenth Dynasty at Memphis', 'The Abydos Dynasty also vanished on the occasion of these southern conquests'. Fourteenth Dynasty page: 'until its demise under the Hyksos 15th Dynasty around 1650 BC'; ruled the 'Nile Delta region'.
